subject: SIG & CAIQ request — inference demarcation pack for Dedicated and Private
messages:
From: Jenna Park <jenna.park@socaudit.com>
To: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 05 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SIG/CAIQ evidence & perimeter diagrams for Dedicated/Private

Hi Priyom,

We're preparing BlueRiver Health's SIG/CAIQ submission and their security team asked for a focused package covering your inference deployments. Specifically they want: 
- High-level network demarcation diagrams showing Dedicated (reserved GPU pools) vs Private (VPC/on-prem) boundaries, including control-plane separation, data-plane flows, and egress restrictions.
- A concise CAIQ crosswalk (pointer to sections) for items related to isolation, key management, and audit logs.
- Any runbook notes for on-prem air-gapped installs that affect evidence (e.g., how you attest logical boundaries in an air-gapped private deployment).

Target timeline: can you provide a deliverable by EOD Thu Aug 7? If not, let me know a realistic date. Also please include a single ZIP with diagrams + CAIQ mapping and a short README.

Thanks,
Jenna Park
SOC Audit — Technical Reviewer
SOC Audit, Inc.
--
Attachment: SIG-ask-template.docx (ref)

Thanks for the clear list. We can produce the package by EOD Thu Aug 7. Plan:

— Priyom

Kimberly / Marcus / Marissa — forwarding Jenna's ask. 2-day turnaround requested. Brief asks below: 

Marcus: can you produce two annotated PNGs (one for Hosted/Dedicated, one for Private/VPC & on-prem) with these callouts: control-plane endpoints, KV cache/data-plane flow, egress filter points, KMS/HSM boundary, and where audits/logs are collected? Prefer vector output but PNG is fine for the ZIP.

Kimberly: please map CAIQ sections relevant to network separation, key mgmt, and logging. A simple 2-column XLSX with CAIQ control -> our artifact/section will work.

Marissa: QA + delivery. Also confirm whether BlueRiver expects a DocuSign attestation (Jenna mentioned possibility).

Let me know if the due date is impossible. I can push for Fri Aug 8 but prefer Thu.

Thanks —
Priyom

Priyom —

Got it. Quick checklist I will own for the CAIQ mapping: 
- Network isolation controls (SC-PL-01 equivalent) -> link to network diagrams + firewall rule summary.
- KMS/HSM key boundary -> pointer to KMS integration doc + key-rotation policy excerpt.
- Audit logs and retention -> Cloudwatch/Stackdriver export points + SIEM handoff notes.
- Private (on-prem) attestation notes -> short paragraph describing the air-gap validation procedure we use during installs.

Marcus — for diagrams, include a small legend that shows: 
- Purple: control plane (management APIs, orchestrator)
- Orange: data plane (model inference, KV caches)
- Red dashed: egress choke points (NAT gateway / proxy)

I'll draft the CAIQ XLSX template tonight and drop the first tab. If you want, I can pull the recent SOC2 network excerpt and paste the relevant snippet into the README.

—Kim
Director, Trust & Security
Redwood Inference
